facts.fact: On 18 November 2025 Mali's Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère personnel (APDP), represented by its president Pr Mamoudou Samassekou, signed with Burkina Faso's CIL and Niger's HAPDP the operational roadmap of the AES coordination framework (CC-APDP-AES), at the Ouagadougou digital week.
